nfelo: Pinned v1 reference CSV, exclude all duplicated IDs, own residual shape needs prior reference seasons, DIFFERENT_CUTOFF_NOT_A_SUPERIORITY_TEST
parameters_selected: Fixed before new candidate comparisons; prior base-only results were already viewed in harvest v1
population: REG 2016-2025, paired populations explicit; postseason affects only subsequent Elo/QB state
promotion_rule: User-authorized update: margin CRPS improves AND total CRPS does not worsen on paired population; separate evidence restrictions still apply; retrospective starter identities not prospective-qualified
qb_aggregation: Ratio of pooled numerators and denominators across previous 10 appearances, not mean of ratios. Team baseline previous 10 team games. Exclude whole target week.
qb_candidate: Same plain Elo state updates; add home-minus-away pre-week ANY/A adjustment at forecast time only
qb_metric: ANY/A=(passing yards +20*pass TD -45*INT -sack yards)/(attempts+sacks). This is not 538 VALUE.
qb_rookie_prior: Prior league pooled ANY/A from previous 256 team-games when no prior QB attempts; explicitly flagged
qb_to_elo: 25 Elo points per 1 ANY/A unit above team baseline, one margin point per ANY/A. Fixed local diagnostic conversion; no tuning or 538 attribution.
shape_fit: Freeze residual histograms before each season using REG games from 2015 through prior season; no evaluation-year labels in shape
starter: Retrospective passer with most official attempts per team-game; sacks excluded from attempts; tie by passer ID; no claim known at T60
total_companion: Same prior-season empirical MARKET total residual histogram centered on league mean of previous 256 completed REG games, excluding target week. Not an Elo total forecast.
